Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A) Nil deviation clause: Compliance to ALL provisions of the bidding document (Nil Deviation bid) is ma ndatory which is to be accepted through the “Seller undertaking” during submis sion of offer by the seller in GeM. Through their acceptance, the seller undertak

es the following: “1. With reference to our bid submitted against the tender, we hereby confirm t hat we comply with all terms, conditions and specifications of the Bidding Docu ments read in conjunction with Amendment(s) / Clarification(s) / Addenda/Errata (if any) issued by the Employer prior to opening of Techno-Commercial Bids and the same has been taken into consideration while making our Techno-Commerc ial Bid & Price Bid and we declare that we have not taken any deviation in this r egard. 2. We understand that in case the Products and/or Services offered do not meet the technical requirements, then our bid shall be rejected as Technically non-re sponsive. We also confirm that in case we refuse to withdraw additional conditions/deviati on s/variations/exception, implicit or explicit, found anywhere in the techno-co mmercial bid, our bid shall be rejected as Technically non-responsive. We further confirm that if any deviation/variation in any form is found in our Pri ce Bid, the EMD shall be forfeited”. B) If any seller/bidder has any clarification against technical specification or oth erwise on any aspect of this bid, they can raise their representation against the same by using the Representation Window provided in the bid details field in Se ller dashboard after logging in as a seller within the time period after bid public ation as allowed by GeM. Clarification asked through any means other than abo ve, may not be considered by NTPC. C) Bidder may quote as per "Technical Specification" and/ or spec sheet attach ed for each line item/ schedule. In case of any contradiction between Category/ BOQ Item description and "Technical Specification" of the item(s) attached in th e tender, TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION OF THAT ITEM SHOULD BE CONSIDERED F OR THE SUBMISSION OF OFFER AND SAME SHALL BE CONSIDERED FOR EVALUA TION PURPOSE AT OUR END. The details mentioned in the detailed Technical sp ecification shall be considered final for the offer/ bid/ technical evaluation. Bidder has to quote make and model in GeM as per option available in GeM duri ng submission of offer after meeting all the technical specification of tender. Aft er opening of bids, any change in vendor's quoted make or model in their bid ca nnot be done and any such request will be rejected. In the event of an order, ve ndor’s quoted make and model in their bid will also get automatically populated in the GEM Purchase order. Also, MSE & MII benefits will be given exclusively ba sed on documents submitted in reference to the "quoted make and model" sub mitted in the GeM bid. D) Guarantee/Warranty: 12 months from the date of use/commissioning or 1 8 months from the date of supply, whichever is earlier. (The Guarantee/ Warran ty Terms and Conditions shall be applicable to the material supplied against the PO. No separate Guarantee/ Warranty Certificate is required to be submitted by the Supplier along with the material. The Guarantee / Warranty terms and condi tion shall be binding on the supplier). If any higher Guarantee/warranty mention ed in the technical specification the same shall be applicable. E) Common IP Addresses: Bidders may please note that GeM is capturing an d presenting to the buyer the IP addresses used by the Buyer and the Bidder(s) /Seller(s). The received bids having matching/common IP address with eith er Bidder(s)/Seller(s) or Buyer, shall be outrightly rejected & shall not be co nsidered for further evaluation.

F) During techno-commercial evaluation of offer, clarification/ reply to the queri es (if asked by NTPC) given by bidder will be considered an integral part of the GeM purchase order and the vendor will be liable to execute the PO also in acco rdance with the same. Furthermore, in the event subsequent clarification(s)/que ry(ies) are sought and bidder fails to respond or responds with incorrect / inadequate or non-compliant information, the bid will be liable to be rejected. S ubsequent representation(s) may not be accepted in such cases. G) All post award communication/ grievance will be addressed to consignee at email id: storeincharge-ramagundam@ntpc.co.in. In case of non-resolution of th e issue, matter can be escalated along with previous correspondence(s) to emai l id:- vendor_grievance_cpg2@ntpc.co.in. H) MSME benefit (purchase preference) is to be given as per following conditions: In case of procurement of goods / services, preferences to MSEs whose quoted prices are within L-1 (non-MSEs) + 15% range (subject to matching of L-1 price) will be given in the following order: a) SC-ST Women MSEs b) SC-ST other than Women MSEs c) Women MSEs d) Other MSEs The MSE order quantity will be as per following: i) Where the requirement is Not-Splitable: 100% of contract quantity will be awa rded to MSEs. ii) Where the requirement is Splitable: 25% of contract quantity will be awarded to MSEs. In case of more than one MSEs (for the same category) are within rang e of L-1 + 15% price, then 25% of tendered quantity will be divided equally amo ngst them. .
